technology_name: IoT Middleware for Smart Transportation Systems (CoSMiC)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Lack of interoperability and secure data exchange challenges between IoT devices and applications
description: CoSMiC is a middleware platform that connects IoT field devices with application software. It supports interoperability, secure data sharing, and deployment of multiple applications within intelligent transportation ecosystems and other IoT environments.
applications:
Smart transportation and intelligent transportation system (ITS) projects
Smart city platforms and urban infrastructure management agencies
IoT solution providers, system integrators, and technology companies
Traffic management, mobility, and transportation analytics organizations
Government agencies and enterprises deploying large-scale IoT ecosystems
